_comment: Catalog of mesh command types (proprietary range 128-255): the meaning of each type for display/labelling. The authoritative set a given relay can run comes from the relay itself (its [commands.commands]); use 'discover' to query it. 'params' describe an optional command payload (reserved for future parameterised commands).

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Reboot the relay (re-opens the boot-time WiFi access window).

commands.name: open-wifi
commands.description: Open the relay's WiFi access window for N minutes (default 30, max 720), no reboot.

commands.name: close-wifi
commands.description: Force the relay's WiFi off now (inverse of open-wifi).

commands.name: restart-stack
commands.description: Soft-restart the mesh stack (concentratord + gateway-relay) without a full reboot.

commands.name: open-lte
commands.description: Turn the relay's LTE on for N minutes (default 30, max 720): modem on, data connection up, VPN over it; off again by itself.

commands.name: close-lte
commands.description: Turn the relay's LTE off now (inverse of open-lte).

commands.name: set-hop-count
commands.description: Set the mesh max hop count (1-8) and persist it.

commands.name: set-filters
commands.description: Set the mesh DevAddr/JoinEUI filters and persist them (replaces both lists; "none" clears).

commands.name: set-direct-uplink
commands.description: Turn the relay's direct uplinks on or off and persist it (off = pure mesh repeater: other relays' frames only).

commands.name: set-filter-relayed
commands.description: Also apply the relay's DevAddr/JoinEUI filters to the uplinks it repeats from other relays (on), or only to the sensors it hears itself (off, default). Persisted.

commands.name: set-enforce-dc
commands.description: Enforce the relay's duty cycle (on: a frame that would exceed its band's budget is dropped) or only track it (off, default). Persisted.

commands.name: set-lorawan-only
commands.description: Drop frames that are neither a data uplink with a DevAddr nor a join request (on; LoRaWAN 1.1 rejoin requests too), or let them pass the filters (off, default). Persisted.

commands.name: set-join-limit
commands.description: Join requests the relay forwards per device (DevEUI) per hour, from the sensors it hears itself (0 = no limit, default 4). Persisted.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Compact health snapshot: uptime, load, temperature, memory, SenOS version, and the relay's duty cycle per band against its limit (dc=M:3.21%/1.00%,L:0.40%/1.00%); while an open-lte window runs, also lte=on(<minutes left>m,catm1|2g).

commands.name: power
commands.description: Charge-controller telemetry: battery, solar, state-of-charge, load (off-grid essentials).

commands.name: version
commands.description: Report the SenOS image version and the mesh component versions (fleet / upgrade tracking).

commands.name: gps-fix
commands.description: Acquire a GPS fix (payload = minutes, default 70, max 90) and persist the relay location; acks immediately, poll with gps-status.

commands.name: gps-status
commands.description: Report GPS acquisition status (state/elapsed/remaining/sats) and the persisted location.

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Connectivity check: the relay replies 'pong' (the ack proves mesh reachability).

commands.name: list-commands
commands.description: Report the command types this relay has configured (mesh discovery).
